chunks: And as for what was narrated - Sa'd ibn Abdillah from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from al-Hasan ibn Musa al-Khashshab from Ghiyath ibn Kalub from Isḥaq ibn 'Ammar from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) from his father that Ali (peace be upon him) used to say:
"Whoever misses fasting the three days that are during the Hajj, let him fast them on the days of Tashriq, for that is permissible for him."
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for making up missed fasting days during Hajj?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), transmitted through the chain of Sa'd ibn Abdullah, establishes a specific legal exception allowing the fast of the Days of Tashriq (11th–13th Dhu al-Hijjah) to compensate for missed obligatory fasts, a ruling that contrasts with the general prohibition of fasting on these days. It highlights the flexibility in Shia jurisprudence regarding the substitution of missed acts of worship during the sacred period of Hajj, emphasizing the principle of ease (taysir) in fulfilling religious obligations.
